cohort: Neonates admitted to the NICU department of Abshway Central Hospital between January 2014 and December 2018, excluding those with major congenital anomalies.
finding: Neonatal jaundice was highly prevalent (59.8%) among NICU admissions, with breastfeeding, inadequate caloric intake, prematurity, septicemia, and Caesarian section deliveries identified as associated factors.
mod_finding: Caesarian section (CS) deliveries were found to be an associated risk factor for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.
cross-section timing: Data collected from hospital records for admissions between January 2014 to December 2018.
